dogecoin.text: RT if you're loyal to your #DogeCoin and didn't sell.

@elonmusk Elon, I sold grandpa's ashes on Ebay - I pushed the dust around until it made the best representation of Jesus Christ I could - then I bought Doge coin with the profits. Pop pop's new ashes came from my BBQ grill but grandma doesn't know. Grandpa Gary loved burgers.
